description: Source code for translation and localization handling in the game, including language setting, file system abstraction, and gettext integration.

classes.name: DaemonInputbuf
classes.description: Stream buffer class that reads from the engine's file system.

classes.name: DaemonIstream
classes.description: Input stream class that owns a DaemonInputbuf.

classes.name: DaemonFileSystem
classes.description: File system abstraction for tinygettext using engine's file functions.

methods.name: Trans_SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets the current language, choosing the closest match if not found.

methods.name: Trans_UpdateLanguage_f
methods.description: Updates language based on current cvar and refreshes UI language.

methods.name: Trans_Init
methods.description: Initializes translation system, loads languages, and sets default language.

methods.name: Trans_Gettext
methods.description: Retrieves translated string for a message ID.

methods.name: Trans_GettextPlural
methods.description: Retrieves pluralized translation based on number.
